Seasonal pre-emergent treatments help prevent many weeds before they become a bigger problem.
Targeted weed control addresses active weeds with treatments suited to your lawn and the season.

For example, a $100 first treatment saves $50; a $200 first treatment saves $75. The offer applies to the first lawn treatment, rather than an ongoing monthly discount. Pricing depends on lawn size and property needs. We’ll prepare a written estimate so you can see your program and price before deciding. Requesting an estimate does not enroll you or authorize a charge.
No long-term lawn service contract is required. Review your estimate and service terms before accepting.
Our core lawn program includes eight treatments per year, generally about five to seven weeks apart. Treatment timing and products change with the season and lawn needs.
We specialize in lawn fertilization and weed control. Mowing is not part of this lawn treatment program.

The right care.
At the right time of year.

Louisiana lawns need more than the same treatment on repeat. Our program changes with the season, your grass type and what’s growing in your yard.

01 / PREVENT

Get ahead of weeds.

Seasonal pre-emergent treatments help prevent many weeds before they become a bigger problem.

02 / CONTROL

Treat what’s there.

Targeted weed control addresses active weeds with treatments suited to your lawn and the season.

03 / NOURISH

Build a stronger lawn.

Fertilization timed to the growing season supports your lawn as part of a consistent, year-round program.

Why start in the fall?

Weed prevention is part of a year-round plan. Starting now lets us review your lawn and plan the next steps through the cooler months and into spring. We’ll explain what your lawn needs in your estimate.

Your neighbors in lawn care

Local roots.
Care you can count on.

Grow Green is a family-owned, firefighter-owned lawn treatment company serving the Greater Baton Rouge area. We believe good service starts with showing up, doing the work and keeping you informed.

  • We specialize in fertilization and weed control.
  • Get a clear price before you decide.
  • Stay informed with service details and photos.
  • Spread program costs with level monthly billing.

Serving Prairieville, Gonzales, Baton Rouge, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, Zachary and surrounding communities. We’ll confirm availability for your address.

Call (225) 461-3199.

How does the November offer work?

Request your free lawn treatment estimate through this page. When you sign up through this November offer, you receive 50% off your first lawn treatment, with a maximum discount of $75. For example, a $100 first treatment saves $50; a $200 first treatment saves $75. The offer applies to the first lawn treatment, rather than an ongoing monthly discount. Your estimate will confirm the details.

How much will my lawn program cost?

Pricing depends on lawn size and property needs. We’ll prepare a written estimate so you can see your program and price before deciding. Requesting an estimate does not enroll you or authorize a charge.

Do I have to sign a long-term contract?

No long-term lawn service contract is required. Review your estimate and service terms before accepting.

How often will you treat my lawn?

Our core lawn program includes eight treatments per year, generally about five to seven weeks apart. Treatment timing and products change with the season and lawn needs.

Do you mow lawns too?

We specialize in lawn fertilization and weed control. Mowing is not part of this lawn treatment program.

When will I hear back?

Most estimates are sent within one business day. Requests received after office hours are handled when our local team returns.

Start yours with 50% off your first lawn treatment. Up to $75 off.
